$doc: docs/DESIGN_Scenario_Regression.md §3 — Air Ops (CE-1118 H-2): a jet's mission ejects its pilot after 40 s. Only Judge (3) is expressible: the jet is abandoned (health 0) and down (below 20 m), and not before its 40 s timer. The new Pilot (type 206) is spawned unnamed, so (1) one pilot, (2) canopy within ~3-4.5 s and (4) landing >= 100 m from the patrol cannot be addressed by a check.

expect.name: the jet is not lost before its 40 s timer
